transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, what finally got me in here is... I've been having some trouble focusing lately. I drive a truck for a living, and over the last few months, my mind just keeps jumping all over the place. 

It's like every little thing catches my attention—a chirp on the CB radio, a fuel price sign on the highway, or just some random new idea that pops into my head. Because of it, I'm starting to miss details that I normally never miss. Things like a client's delivery note or remembering who I promised to call back. It's just getting a bit frustrating, to be honest.
Have you struggled with this kind of difficulty focusing and getting distracted since you were a child, or is this something that only started happening in the last few months?

No, it's definitely not something from when I was a kid. I never really had this kind of trouble before. It's... well, it's been going on for about seven months now. That's right around the time my daughter moved back home, and I just started trying to keep everything steady, you know? So yeah, it's a more recent thing.
Over these past seven months, have you found yourself feeling excessively worried or anxious about a number of different events or activities in your daily life?

Not really, no. I mean... I wouldn't call it worry or anxiety. Sure, it's an adjustment having my daughter back, but I'm not sitting around stressing over every little thing in my day. It's not like I'm scared or nervous about stuff going wrong. It's more just... my mind won't stay put on one thing. So, no, I wouldn't say I've been excessively worried.
During these past seven months, have you felt down, depressed, or have you lost interest in the things you usually enjoy doing?

No, I wouldn't say I've felt depressed or anything like that. I haven't been down in the dumps, and I still like doing the same stuff I always have. It's really just the distraction thing I mentioned.
Do you find that you've been drinking more alcohol than usual over these past seven months?
No, I haven't. I mean... I might have a beer every now and then, but nothing more than usual. It definitely hasn't picked up or changed over the last few months.
Have you been diagnosed with any new medical conditions or started taking any new medications in the last seven months?
No, nothing like that. My health has been pretty steady. I haven't been to a doctor for anything new, and I'm not taking any new pills or anything.
Since your daughter moved back home seven months ago, have you felt that this change has caused you significant distress or difficulty in your daily functioning?

Yeah, I suppose it has been causing some trouble. Like, at work... I’ve had to have dispatch and some of my clients repeat details that I really should have kept track of. And a couple of my sales follow-ups actually slipped through the cracks because I was just chasing too many ideas at once. 

Then at home, it's... well, my wife and daughter have been kind of walking on eggshells around me. I can tell I’m adding strain to the house when I’m really supposed to be the one helping them out.
Have you noticed any physical signs of tension, such as muscle aches, trouble sleeping, or feeling physically restless since your daughter moved back home?

No, not really. I mean, I get a little stiff sometimes from driving all day, but that's nothing new. I haven't had any extra muscle aches or felt physically restless. And I'm not tossing and turning from tension or anything like that. Physically, I feel pretty normal.
